findings.summary: Same-connection reauthorization leaves stale channel work beyond a fixed 1,000-row cap.
findings.details: S04-T02 requires same-connection reauthorization to preserve channel keys/cursors while incrementing the credentials generation. commitReconcileChannels only loads take(1_000) sourceChannels for the connection before promoting old-generation rows and patching their channelSyncStates to the incremented generation. In Slack workspaces with more than 1,000 channel rows, unvisited old-generation channels and their live/recent/deep/reconciliation sync cursors can remain on the stale generation after reauthorization, so later work can observe stale generation state instead of the new credential fence. The focused partial-page tests prove a small-row case but do not prove the all-rows reauthorization invariant.
